name: How long does a whole-home renovation usually take?

mainEntity.name: How long does a whole-home renovation usually take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of a whole-home renovation varies significantly based on the project's scope and complexity. Minor cosmetic updates might take a few weeks, while extensive remodels involving structural changes, multiple room reconfigurations, and custom finishes can extend to several months, or even over a year. Material lead times, permit approvals, and unexpected discoveries during demolition are all factors that can influence the timeline.
acceptedAnswer.description: The timeline for a whole-home renovation depends on its scope and complexity, ranging from weeks for minor updates to over a year for extensive remodels.
